user.title: TA CMI Webportal
user.description: Choose the custom profile for new devices. Use legacy UVR1611 only after verifying its schematic layout.

reauth_confirm.title: TA portal credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Update the login credentials for this CMI.

error.cannot_connect: The CMI online schematic could not be read. Check credentials, device number, schematic, and permissions.
error.invalid_cmi: Use a CMI number in the format CMI123456.

add.title: Add point from the CMI schematic
add.description: Position is a div ID such as pos13. Writable controls require an actual loadChanger link and a CMI dropdown. Link index starts at 0.

discover.title: Choose a discovered position
discover.description: These positions are currently visible in the CMI schematic. Choose one to configure it.

settings.title: Polling interval
settings.description: How often should the CMI portal be polled? 120 seconds recommended. Saving automatically reloads this integration.

climate.title: Configure thermostat
climate.description: Only your mapped sensor/number/select points. Mode labels must match CMI choices exactly. No independent heating control.

error.invalid_point: Invalid name, position or binary labels.
error.duplicate_point: This point is already mapped as that entity type.
error.invalid_climate: Invalid climate mapping or duplicate mode labels.

abort.no_points: No custom entities have been configured yet.
abort.no_schema: No positions available yet. Try again after a successful update.
abort.no_climate_points: First add a °C sensor and a writable °C number point.
